**This file is committed to git.** It is meant to be — you should be able to see how it changes as your
working style changes. Anything you would not want in version control belongs in `CLAUDE.local.md` instead,
which is already listed in `.gitignore` and loads automatically alongside `CLAUDE.md`.

`CLAUDE.md` imports this file, so everything here is in context at the start of every session. That makes it
expensive: keep entries short, and delete ones that stop being true.
